latency_note: Mean over the five frozen queries after one warm-up query on CPU. Model/process startup is excluded. Wall-clock values vary with CPU scheduling, PyTorch, and BLAS versions.
bottleneck: The cross-encoder reranker accounts for approximately 97.6% of measured warm retrieval latency. It was not replaced or reconfigured in Stage 3.4.
provenance_policy: Unavailable source_id and document_version values are returned as null and are never inferred.
